ValidationRule.description: Restricts Users from reopening a Lost Opp if they are no the Owner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Closed Lost"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Not Upsold")), RecordType.Name ="Historical" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't update a historical record. Please reach out to the Salesforce Information Slack channel with your request
